sm: Georgia Howe opens the Monday, November 23rd edition of Evening Wire, with John Bickley out today. Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO under pressure, including from the president, and the stock soared more than 30 percent. Huang had resigned earlier in the month. President Trump celebrated on Truth Social, saying Huang, who had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, posed no threat to national security.

Democrats have secured at least 258 House seats, their largest majority in more than three decades, last matched in 1992. The 258th seat came when Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Virginia Fox in North Carolina's 5th district by 330 votes after a recount. The Democratic National Committee also released plans for 12 presidential debates from June 2027 through March 2028, with crowded early debates possibly split across two nights and no more than 20 candidates overall.

New Foreign Agents Registration Act filings show the Berson Group is working for Al Jazeera to build awareness among American audiences, media, and policy makers. The team includes a former State Department official, a former CBS News producer, and a former chief of staff to a Republican member of Congress. Marco Rubio signed letters in 2019, 2020, and 2021 urging Al Jazeera to register. Separately, Ukraine says it used sea drones to strike a Russian warship docked in Benghazi, Libya, though damage details are unavailable.

The United Nations Climate Summit in Turkey ended Sunday without an overarching agreement after disputes over fossil fuels and climate financing. The European Union and others rejected a draft because it did not explicitly call for a transition away from fossil fuels and instead stressed carbon capture. Developing nations said they need up to 6.8 trillion dollars through 2030. It is the first failure to adopt a deal since 2009. Honda is recalling over 800,000 vehicles over airbag inflators that could rupture, though Honda says it has no evidence of real-world failures.

Airlines are seeing delays and cancellations ahead of Thanksgiving. Delta cancelled over 2,000 flights after a system outage at Atlanta's airport, and more travelers are renting cars. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani will have surgery Friday for a torn Achilles tendon suffered in a soccer game with the press corps, and will wear a boot for six to eight weeks.

Two competing claims have emerged on the Riemann hypothesis, a 165-year-old problem about prime numbers with a million dollar prize. Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpoge announced he believes he and Claude proved it. Hours later, a Stanford mathematician published a separate human-written proof by Alessandro Maria Masullo. Neither has been verified, and both need extensive review. The show closes with a recap of earlier stories on a possible shutdown, an FBI database hack, and a captured cartel boss.
